metadata.title: Septic
metadata.description: Utilities Septic in Pinellas County, Florida. Septic location data created from analysis and research performed by Hazen Consulting services on behalf of Pinellas County Utilities (PCU) and other county departments is still being adjusted for accuracy and completeness. The primary purpose of the research was for development of Pinellas County Utilities' Septic to Sewer program. Data in this layer was delivered to PCU in 2023. In 2024 some location candidates for the Septic to Sewer program are entering design/construction phase. Future updates to this layer are TBD and workflows for such are in development in 2026. Additional detailed information regarding the development of this dataset can be found in the Project Deliverable Documentation The data contained herein is offered “as is,” with no claim or warranty as to its accuracy or completeness.
